summary: Apply a process to neighbourhood windows of a data cube
description: Applies a process to rolling windows of a raster data cube, reducing each window to a single value. Window extent is given per dimension by `size`, optionally widened by `overlap`. A EURAC custom process developed for the interTwin project.

parameters.name: process
parameters.description: Process to apply to each window. Receives the window as `data` and is expected to reduce it to a single value.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The values of one neighbourhood window.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Additional data passed by the user.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Window size per dimension, given as a mapping of dimension name to window length in pixels.

parameters.name: overlap
parameters.description: Additional pixels added on each side of the window, per dimension. Each dimension grows by twice its overlap value.

returns.description: A raster data cube with the same dimensions, each value derived from its neighbourhood window.
